briefdescription.para: Release a device from every subsystem that has it allocated.

detaileddescription.para: Releases the given device from every subsystem that currently has it allocated.

Looks up the device's runtime requirement list and calls XPmDevice_Release with a secure command for each allocated entry, stopping at the first error. Successful releases clear the corresponding allocation and requirements via the normal device-release path.

parameterdescription.para: Device whose allocated requirements are released.

simplesect.para: XST_INVALID_PARAM if Device is NULL, XST_FAILURE if its runtime operations record is absent, or the status of the last attempted XPmDevice_Release call. If no entry is allocated, returns XST_FAILURE.

briefdescription.para: Releases requirements according to the requested scope.

parameterdescription.para: Release scope selecting which requirements are released

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or an error code

inbodydescription.para: Release all device from given subsystem from the requirement

briefdescription.para: Triggers the setting for scheduled requirements.

parameterdescription.para: Subsystem which changed the state and whose scheduled requirements are triggered
Flag stating should current requirements be saved as next

simplesect.para: a) swap=false Set scheduled requirements of a subsystem without swapping current and next requirements - means the current requirements will be dropped. Upon every self suspend, subsystem has to explicitly re-request device requirements. b) swap=true Set scheduled requirements of a subsystem with swapping current and next requirements (swapping means the current requirements will be saved as next, and will be configured once subsystem wakes-up).

briefdescription.para: Checks whether the given requirement is the exclusive allocation of its device, i.e.

detaileddescription.para: no other subsystem has the device allocated.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if the requirement is exclusive else XST_FAILURE
